name: Bottlebrush sedge
desc: Bottlebrush sedge (Carex hystericina): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carex hystericina is a species of sedge known by the common names bottlebrush sedge and porcupine sedge. It is native to North America and Canada through to Mexico and Jamaica.
